title: State the holding of this case in one paragraph, with the cite. (success)
story: Reference run: right tools, answer fully supported by what was read.
description: Search the folder, open the opinion, then write the paragraph. The cite is the opinion that was opened.
expected_reference: Delacroix v. Ostrander, 450 F.4th 1085 (2021) (14th Cir.): A non-compete covenant ancillary to the sale of a business interest is enforceable only insofar as its geographic and temporal scope is reasonably necessary to protect the goodwill transferred. A restriction exceeding the territory where the business operated at sale is unreasonable as to the excess. The court may blue-pencil (narrow) the clause rather than void it. The court reversed and remanded for the restriction to be tailored to the three counties where the business operated.
